source.title: Phenylalanyl-tRNA Synthetase and Isoleucyl-tRNAPhe: A Possible Verification Mechanism for Aminoacyl-tRNA

evidence.quote: The misacylated product is shown here to be hydrolyzed by highly purified phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase from E. coli, with release of isoleucine and active tRNAPhe.
The synthesis of isoleucyl-tRNAPhe (Escherichia coli) proceeds at an appreciable rate under normal in vitro conditions in the presence of isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase (EC 6.1.1.5) from E. coli.
